types.name: Alligation of two prices or strengths
types.description: Two kinds (prices per kg, percent purity) are mixed; find the mixing ratio, the quantity of one kind, or the mean price of the mixture.

types.name: Alligation with profit, interest or speed
types.description: Alligation used on profit percents, interest rates, speeds or a selling price with a gain, rather than plain cost prices.

types.name: Adding water or one ingredient
types.description: Pure water (or pure milk, acid or one ingredient) is added to a mixture to reach a new percent or ratio; one component stays fixed.

types.name: Mixing two mixtures
types.description: Two vessels or alloys with different ratios or percents are mixed in a given ratio (or a ratio must be found) to get a new mixture.

types.name: Removal and replacement
types.description: Part of a liquid is taken out and replaced by water (or another liquid), once or several times, or the part to replace must be found.

types.name: Remove some mixture, then add different amounts
types.description: Some mixture is removed and then different quantities of one or more ingredients are added (or moved to another vessel); track each ingredient step by step.
